intro.h2: See the tile, then see it installed
paragraphs: Preferred Tile, LLC is a family-owned tile store in Statesboro that has been in business for over 60 years. The showroom on N Zetterower Avenue carries porcelain, natural stone, mosaics and tile in all sizes, and the staff help you choose what fits your room.

The shop also installs. Recent bathrooms on the Facebook page include walk-in showers with built-in niches and benches, mosaic accent bands, pebble floors and travertine walls. A builder who has used Wayne and his crew on several custom houses calls them always professional. If you are planning a shower, floor or full bath, start with a visit.

about.h2: About Wayne and the Preferred Tile family
about.text: Preferred Tile, LLC is a locally owned family business in Statesboro, Georgia, and has been in operation for over 60 years. Wayne is the owner, and he invites customers to call and ask for him by name. The store sits at 9 N Zetterower Avenue, with a showroom full of tile boards and displays. Every so often the family holds a tile yard sale behind the building, with porcelain, natural stone, mosaics and more. With 930 likes on Facebook, the shop shares its finished showers and baths there.

image.alt: Preferred Tile storefront on N Zetterower Avenue with a white pickup truck parked outside

process.h2: How to start your tile project

steps.title: Visit the showroom
steps.text: Stop by 9 N Zetterower Ave, Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM, and look at tile in person.

steps.title: Choose your tile
steps.text: Staff help you compare porcelain, natural stone and mosaics and pick what suits your shower, floor or bath.

steps.title: Plan the install
steps.text: Ask Wayne about installation, including who will do the work, the schedule and what is included, before anything starts.

steps.title: Install and finish
steps.text: Your tile is installed and the job is checked with you. If anything needs attention later, call and ask for Wayne.

service_area.text: Preferred Tile, LLC is at 9 N Zetterower Ave in Statesboro, Georgia, and its project posts are from the Statesboro area. Homeowners and builders come to the showroom to pick tile and plan their showers, floors and baths. If your project is outside Statesboro, call (912) 764-7767 and ask Wayne whether installation is available where you live and how scheduling works.

items.q: What kinds of tile do you carry?
items.a: Porcelain, natural stone, mosaics and tile in all sizes, based on what the store lists for its tile sales. The best way to see current stock is to visit the showroom at 9 N Zetterower Ave, Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM, or call (912) 764-7767.

items.q: Do you install tile or just sell it?
items.a: Both. The shop posts finished showers and bathrooms, and builders hire Wayne and his crew for custom homes. When you plan your job, ask who will do the installation, how scheduling works and what is included, so you know exactly what to expect.

items.q: How long have you been in business?
items.a: The Facebook page describes Preferred Tile as a locally owned family business that has been in operation for over 60 years in Statesboro. Wayne is the owner, and customers can call the store and ask for him by name with any questions.

The showroom is open Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM and closed on Saturday and Sunday. Call (912) 764-7767 during those hours, or email Preferredtilellc@gmail.com with your room size, photos and the look you want, and the store will follow up.

Yes. One custom home client wrote that Wayne and his guys have done several custom houses for them and called the team always professional. Builders can call (912) 764-7767 and ask for Wayne to talk about tile selections and schedules for new homes.
